steps.what: Monitor construction conditions and compare observed activities with applicable environmental and regulatory requirements

tasks.design: Retain site observation and compliance judgement with the engineer, using controlled requirements in {DOCS}. A record system can support evidence access, but it cannot replace observing actual construction conditions.
tasks.previous_blocker: Compliance depends on site conditions and the applicability of project-specific obligations.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing controlled records support the engineer without eliminating monitoring work.
tasks.still_hard: A complete checklist can miss an unanticipated environmental impact.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer recognises deviations and seeks the right specialist interpretation.
tasks.altitude: No assumed change in monitoring time or authority.

reach.learn: Connect observed site conditions to environmental evidence requirements.

evidence.claim: Relatics supports requirements and verification records; this does not establish actual construction compliance.

assumptions: Boundary is the engineer's monitoring and follow-up recommendation; contractor remediation and formal authority determinations are separate.
Engineer produces observations and applicability judgements in s1; no free structured compliance flag is assumed.
Consider native requirements records first. Zero upkeep because no new automation or capture workflow is proposed; actual applicable national rules remain to be confirmed.
unknowns: Existing inspection records and specialist responsibilities
research_questions: Which observation failures would remain invisible to a document-only compliance dashboard?

already_counted.description: All observation and compliance judgement remain counted.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100 R=100 gross=0 net=0. No site observation or requirement interpretation is removed.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Direct wind farm construction and commissioning

steps.what: Direct construction, installation and commissioning while resolving specification deviations and site coordination issues

tasks.design: Keep construction and commissioning direction with the engineer using specifications in {DOCS}. Existing project tools assist coordination, while instructions that affect installation and testing remain accountable human decisions.
tasks.previous_blocker: Site sequencing and technical deviations need context and negotiation.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing controlled drawings and test records support direction without replacing it.
tasks.still_hard: Conflicting site constraints can require an engineering change rather than a routine instruction.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer resolves deviations and knows when work must stop or escalate.
tasks.altitude: No assumed reduction in site leadership or change in authority.

reach.learn: Coordinate installation boundaries and technical hold points.

evidence.claim: Retaining construction and commissioning leadership is model knowledge; no task-specific measured saving is asserted.

assumptions: Boundary is engineering direction; contractor installation labour, test execution and separate compliance monitoring are excluded.
Engineer assesses raw progress and test observations within s1; no free readiness, test-pass or compliance classification is assumed.
Use existing native project controls first. Zero upkeep because no additional workflow is proposed.
research_questions: Which instructions require cross-discipline approval beyond this engineer's existing authority?

already_counted.description: Coordination, technical decisions and checked instructions remain counted.

approvals.approved_version: Exact instruction, affected equipment, specification revision and conditions; changes require renewed review.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100 R=100 gross=0 net=0. Site direction remains fully counted without assuming project runtime is human effort.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Analyse wind farm reliability and performance

steps.what: Reconcile operation records, component identities and specification applicability for the analysis period
Calculate reliability and performance indicators and compare values against specified limits
Interpret operation results, investigate departures and judge performance against applicable specifications

tasks.design: Configure repeatable calculations in {SPREADSHEET} using the engineer's checked export from the wind farm monitoring historian {OTHER}. Keep missing-data judgements, operating-context interpretation and specification assessment with the engineer in {DOCS}.
tasks.previous_blocker: Time windows, event classifications and component versions require reconciliation before indicators are comparable.
tasks.enabler_now: Native formulas and saved views can repeat the agreed calculations.
tasks.still_hard: Curtailment, weather variation and missing intervals can make raw availability or output misleading.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer distinguishes a data artifact from an actual reliability problem.
tasks.altitude: Less indicator recalculation; operational and compliance decisions retain their owners.

reach.learn: Explain uncertainty and distinguish repeated failure from operating restrictions.

evidence.claim: Repeatable wind operation indicator calculations are model knowledge; no digest case establishes this role's savings.

assumptions: Boundary starts with operating and maintenance records already produced in normal operations; acquisition and repair labour remain outside and unchanged.

In s1 engineer produces turbine/component IDs, configuration versions, timestamps, units, energy values, failure events, exposure hours, curtailment classifications, missing intervals, formula definitions and applicable limits with source references. Capture, classification and checking are counted; unresolved records stay in manual analysis.
OTHER means wind farm monitoring historian. Test native calculations and reporting first; unattended historian runtime earns no saving.
research_questions: Can the calculation distinguish curtailment and missing telemetry from equipment downtime?

already_counted.description: Dataset reconciliation and contextual engineering interpretation.

incremental.description: Maintain indicator definitions and checked regression periods.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100 R=70 gross=30 net=22 after 8 upkeep. Zero if indicators already exist natively; 5 if a limited recurring manual calculation set benefits.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Investigate wind turbine component failure causes

steps.what: Investigate component failures through physical evidence, operating history and discriminating engineering tests

tasks.design: Retain component root cause investigation with the engineer, recording competing explanations and evidence in {DOCS}. Existing analysis tools can support individual tests, but automated report grouping does not establish causation.
tasks.previous_blocker: Sparse evidence and interacting loading, material and installation factors make causes uncertain.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing records assist reconstruction while investigation remains necessary.
tasks.still_hard: Damage observed after failure may obscure the initiating mechanism.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer chooses tests that distinguish plausible causes and states unresolved uncertainty.
tasks.altitude: No assumed change in failure investigation effort or authority.

reach.learn: Specify inspections that discriminate initiating defects from secondary damage.

evidence.claim: Retaining physical evidence interpretation and causal engineering analysis is model knowledge; no labour saving is established.

assumptions: Boundary is case-specific failure investigation, excluding general reliability monitoring already scoped elsewhere and repair implementation.
Engineer produces hypotheses and evidence assessments in s1; no preclassified root cause or structured failure mechanism is assumed.
Consider native analysis tools first. Zero upkeep because this design introduces no automated workflow.
unknowns: Access to component load and installation histories
research_questions: What independent observation would falsify the leading failure hypothesis?

already_counted.description: Physical investigation, evidence analysis and causal judgement remain counted.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100 R=100 gross=0 net=0. No causal investigation or physical evidence work is removed.

role.altitude: Repeatable operational indicators can shrink preparation while construction oversight and failure investigation remain human engineering.
reach: Coordinate environmental monitoring, commissioning interfaces and targeted component examinations.
role.ambitious_version: An engineer whose operational comparisons are reproducible and whose site judgements remain grounded in direct evidence.
